items.reasoning: The requested SVD dilation and first three rubric criteria are true, but the final universal postselection necessity in the question, answer, rubric4, summary and step3 is false as stated. S=sqrt(I-Sigma^2) is real diagonal and commutes with Sigma; the middle block is Hermitian and squares to diag(Sigma^2+S^2,S^2+Sigma^2)=I. Multiplying the unitary outer factors yields top-left W Sigma V†=A and upper-right W S. Thus the exact one-ancilla construction is valid for every stipulated contraction, including singular and zero A. Also no nonunitary A equals a system-only unitary AS AN EXACT LINEAR OPERATOR on every input. That fact does not imply every implementation of its normalized output state requires an ancilla and probabilistic postselection. Take A=cI on an n-qubit system with real0<c<1. It satisfies every original premise and is nonunitary, yet A|b>/||A|b>||=|b> for every normalized input: the native identity produces the desired normalized state deterministically without any ancillary qubit. In the displayed dilation the selected success probability is c^2, but that is a property of this chosen unnormalized branch, not a universal lower bound for all state-generation procedures. Likewise A=diag(1,1/2) and input|0> have selected success1 despite A being nonunitary. If A|b>=0, conditioning on the success branch is undefined and must not be described as recovering a normalized output. A deterministic operation cannot equal the subnormalized branch rho->A rho A† for every density when A†A differs from I, because that branch fails trace preservation on some inputs. Keeping that exact-branch assertion distinct from normalized state preparation salvages the useful impossibility statement without the universal claim. Primary Example9.3 proves the block construction and explicitly withholds an efficient one-/two-qubit implementation; Figure9.1/9.2 describe postselection of that construction, not universal necessity. Correcting the final requested claim requires an explicit question successor; an answer-only replacement or new standing premise would silently change the false demand.
